import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 250005;
    static final int M = 1 << 17;
    static final int D = 18;

    static int P;
    static int L, K;
    static long[] fac = new long[N];
    static int[] bitcnt = new int[N];
    static int[] bit = new int[20];
    static int n = 0, m;
    static long[][] suma = new long[D][M];
    static long[][] sumc = new long[D][M];
    static long[][] dp = new long[D][M];
    static long[][] tmp = new long[D][M];

    static long power(long a, int t) {
        long r = 1;
        a %= P;
        while (t > 0) {
            if ((t & 1) == 1) r = (r * a) % P;
            a = (a * a) % P;
            t >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        L = sc.nextInt();
        K = sc.nextInt();
        P = sc.nextInt();

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) {
            fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % P;
            bitcnt[i] = bitcnt[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
        }

        long all = power(K, L);
        if ((L & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(all);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        long invFacL = power(fac[(int) L], P - 2);
        for (int i = (int) L; i >= 1; i--) {
            fac[i - 1] = (fac[i] * i) % P;
        }
        for (int i = 1; (1 << i) <= L; i++) {
            if (((L >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                bit[n++] = 1 << i;
            }
        }

        m = 1 << n;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int s = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    s += bit[j];
                }
            }
            suma[bitcnt[i]][i] = (i == 0) ? 1 : 0;
            if (s == 0) {
                suma[bitcnt[i]][i] = 1;
            } else {
                suma[bitcnt[i]][i] = 1; // placeholder, will be updated below
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
            for (int l = m; l >= 2; l >>= 1) {
                int half = l >> 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j += l) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                        suma[t][j + k + half] = (suma[t][j + k + half] + suma[t][j + k]) % P;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
            System.arraycopy(suma[t], 0, dp[t], 0, m);
        }

        int cc = 0;
        int revK = 0;
        int tempK = K;
        while (tempK > 0) {
            revK = (revK << 1) | (tempK & 1);
            cc++;
            tempK >>= 1;
        }
        cc--;
        for (; cc >= 0; cc--, revK >>= 1) {
            for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    tmp[t][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
                for (int b = 0; a + b <= n; b++) {
                    long[] f = tmp[a + b];
                    long[] g = dp[a];
                    long[] h = dp[b];
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                        f[j] = (f[j] + g[j] * h[j]) % P;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
                System.arraycopy(tmp[t], 0, dp[t], 0, m);
            }

            if ((revK & 1) == 1) {
                for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                        tmp[t][j] = 0;
                    }
                }
                for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
                    for (int b = 0; a + b <= n; b++) {
                        long[] f = tmp[a + b];
                        long[] g = dp[a];
                        long[] h = suma[b];
                        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                            f[j] = (f[j] + g[j] * h[j]) % P;
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
                    System.arraycopy(tmp[t], 0, dp[t], 0, m);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
            System.arraycopy(dp[t], 0, sumc[t], 0, m);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
            for (int l = 2; l <= m; l <<= 1) {
                int half = l >> 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j += l) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                        sumc[t][j + k + half] = (sumc[t][j + k + half] - sumc[t][j + k] + P) % P;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = (all - (sumc[n][(1 << n) - 1] * fac[(int) L] % P) + P) % P;
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
